A '''Celastrus tree''' is a high-level tree that can be grown with the [[Farming]] skill. Players with at least level 85 Farming may plant a [[celastrus sapling]] in the high-tier area of the [[Farming Guild]]. The nearby farmer can be paid 8 [[potato cacti]] to protect a planted celastrus tree from becoming [[Disease (Farming)|diseased]].

Celastrus trees are grown by first planting a [[celastrus seed]] in a [[filled plant pot]], which will turn into a [[celastrus sapling]] after being watered and allowed to grow. The celastrus sapling is then planted in the [[celastrus patch]], in the advanced tier of the [[Farming Guild]], using a spade.

Once fully grown, checking the health of the tree yields 14,130 Farming experience and can then be chopped with an [[axe]] to produce a minimum of three [[celastrus bark]] for 23.5 Farming experience per bark. The yield of celastrus bark can be improved by composting the patch before it is fully grown,{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1088630402284224512|date=24 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98850|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=Yes, celastrus would be helped by composting.}} having [[Magic secateurs]] equipped or in your inventory,{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1092832728830095360|date=05 February 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109014|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=I can't offer to go read the code for you from here, but I think so.}} having a higher Farming level, and having an [[Attas seed]] planted.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1250487359730302978|date=15 April 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/105048|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=Yes, that effect is tied into the core of harvesting where it does indeed affect Celastrus.}} [[Nature offerings]] do '''not''' increase the yield of Celastrus bark, however. Once all of the bark has been harvested the tree will remain depleted until removed. The fully harvested tree must be cut down and then cleared using a spade.

Due to the high cost of [[Celastrus seed|celastrus seeds]], it is recommended to pay the farmer for protection, as this only requires 8 [[potato cactus]] which is incredibly cheap compared to the cost of the seed. Additionally, players should use [[ultracompost]] and [[Magic secateurs]] to increase the yield from each tree.

Growing a celastrus tree, harvesting the [[celastrus bark]], and using a knife to create a [[Battlestaff]] is required for a [[Kourend & Kebos Diary|Kourend & Kebos Elite Diary]] task.

==Trivia==
*''{{WP|Celastrus}}'' is a genus of shrubs and vines commonly known as staff vines, staff trees, and bittersweets.
*Vines in the genus ''Celasturs'' often coil around themselves, leading to common names such as "twinning vine"
